channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — game-datasets
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: unicum.gg — via game-datasets
item.description: World of Tanks player, clan, tank and map statistics across EU, NA and Asia, free and with no key. Website.

item.title: OSTDB — via game-datasets
item.description: Official video game soundtracks (2,300+ albums for 1,800+ games) with Spotify, Apple Music and album.link URLs, as CSV, JSON and SQLite. Website, API.

item.title: PixelGamesHub — via game-datasets
item.description: Curated index of AI-powered browser games.

item.title: Nash Push/Fold Ranges for Tournament Poker — via game-datasets
item.description: Chip-EV Nash shove frequency for all 169 hold'em hands at every seat, 1 to 25 big blinds.

item.title: BJJGraph — via game-datasets
item.description: Transition graph behind a Brazilian jiu-jitsu sparring game, with estimated gi and no-gi outcome probabilities.

item.title: PlayerSells Open Data — via game-datasets
item.description: Measured streaming and creator datasets: Kick and Twitch viewing by category, simulcasting, and follower and engagement benchmarks (CC BY 4.0).

item.title: Planet Zoo 2 launch dataset — via game-datasets
item.description: Species data with biome, enclosure, taxonomy and conservation fields, plus a pairwise cohabitation compatibility matrix.

item.title: Co-op Game Night Data — via game-datasets
item.description: Dated co-op game metadata with official sources, player-cap uncertainty, CSV and JSON exports, and a local filtering tool.

item.title: Slay the Spire Runs — via game-datasets
item.description: 77 million Slay the Spire Runs from 2018-2020.

item.title: GameScope — via game-datasets
item.description: Gaming video quality dataset: 4,048 UGC and PGC clips from 74 games, encoded with H.264, H.265 and AV1, each with about 37 mean opinion scores plus quality attributes. Paper, Code.

item.title: Pokémon Card Sold-Price Reference by Grade — via game-datasets
item.description: Median sold prices by grade (raw, PSA 9, PSA 10) and sample counts for 486 Pokémon TCG cards.

item.title: Pokémon Card Centering Measurements — via game-datasets
item.description: Measured centering percentages (L/R and T/B) on 302 real Pokémon TCG eBay listings, with PSA 10 pass/fail windows.
